newsitem.title: USA: BioCryst in drug discovery pact.
newsitem.headline: BioCryst in drug discovery pact.

text.p: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals Inc and 3-Dimensional Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday they signed a drug discovery collaboration.

The two said they will share resources and technology to speed up the discovery of new drug candidates for BioCryst's program for inhibiting "complement," a biological process that can result in damaging inflammatory reactions within the body.

Under the terms of the 50-50 agreement, the companies will conduct joint research to identify inhibitors of key serine proteases, enzymes thought to represent promising targets for inhibiting complement activation.
If lead compounds are discovered as a result of the pact, the companies said they will then negotiate clinical development and commercialization rights to the compounds.
No further terms of the deal were disclosed.
Complement operates by starting a chain reaction of enzyme activation, or a cascade, resulting in an inflammatory response to protect the body.
If the mechanism is inappropriately activated, it can cause acute medical conditions, including inflammatory reactions that come with hemodialysis, heart attacks and bypass surgery.
